'''Ardees Beverage''' was a [[Tea/Legends|tea]] brand sold by the [[Ardees Beverage Company/Legends|Ardees Beverage Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Ardees_Beverage_tea_girl.png|thumb|left|150px|A school girl drinking Ardees Beverage tea]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] smuggling ring attempted to increase their income by diluting their shipments of the tea brand, which they brought from the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]]-run world of [[Mooga/Legends|Mooga]]. The dilution agent used was [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]], a substance that could be lethal if combined incorrectly with other fluids. The diluted tea caused illness in [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] children who drank it, leading the ring to be violently disbanded and its leaders and several members arrested or killed in resistance to arrest.
